objective: Close exact MILK_2_5 seven-BREAKFAST resilience with one accepted cheese sandwich while preserving fail-closed rejection of the butter card and expanding existing sandwich compatibility without Planner changes.
boundary_note: This closes exclusion of exact canonical MILK_2_5 only. It is not a dairy-allergy claim because the selected cheese sandwich contains dairy.

rejected.reason: The source declares 5 g cream butter but only 0.98 g fat for the whole sandwich. TR TS 033/2013 defines cream butter at >=50% fat, so the butter alone contributes at least 2.5 g fat. Arithmetic self-consistency of the declared macros does not resolve this component contradiction.
